# dsh-notify-win
> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Windows notification plugin — native toast + taskbar flash when a task fini
shes or your input is needed.
English | 中文
## 📸 Screenshots
## ✨ Features

- 🔔 **Native Windows toast** (bottom-right, Win10/11 system style)
- 💡 **Taskbar flash** (`FlashWind

owEx`) when DSH is in the background; the OS stops it as soon as DSH comes to the foreground
- 🖱️ **

Click-to-focus** — clicking a toast opens DSH and switches to the corresponding session
- ✅ Triggers

when a **task finishes** (root agent goes `idle`)
- 🧭 **Tells you WHY it stopped** — the toast refl
ects the `turn/end` reason instead of always claiming success: normal finish, output-token ceiling (
`max-tokens`), blocked pre-step, LLM failure (provider-neutral code + retry count), or cancellation.

See Stop conditions.
- 🗜️ Triggers when **context compaction finishes** — and alerts when it **fail

s** (`compaction/end` with `error`)
- ❓ Triggers when **your input is needed** (approval / `ask_user

_question`)
- 📋 **Question toast with pages**: a single question shows its native dropdown (up to 5
options) plus a custom-answer text box. Two or more questions become one paged toast (`问题 i/n` + 上一题
/ 下一题 / 提交 / 取消); every page keeps its dropdown choice and custom text when you page back, and a `已

答：…` line keeps the other answers visible.
- 🧷 **Resident helper, plugin lifetime**: one `dsh-toast-
question.exe` is started when the plugin is applied and reused for every question. Disabling the plu
gin or quitting DSH shuts it down (stdio EOF when DSH exits), so no per-question process spawn and n

o orphan process.
- ✅ **One honest receipt**: submitting closes the question toast; nothing else pop
s up until the model answers, and then exactly one toast appears — the **model's first line**, fille
d to the toast width and cut with `…` when it is longer (no “已提交” / “已送达” / “已收到并回应” stages, no titl
e line). Text that can only exist if the whole round trip really happened. If the model produces no
visible text, nothing is shown (no invented receipt). Cancelling says “没有向 DSH 提交任何答案”; a card that

could not be filled says “请在 DSH 窗口中手动回答”.
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (x64)
- DeepSeek Harness, any profile (`web` recommended)
- .NET 10 Desktop Runtime
(x64) — **required**: the resident toast helper is the only notification implementation. All toasts
(done / compact / alert / notice, interactive approval and questions) go through it. Install with `w
inget install Microsoft.DotNet.DesktopRuntime.10` or from <https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dot
net/10.0>. No PowerShell script is used.
## How it works
| Concern | Implementation |
| Trigger "done"/alert/notice | `session/event` → `turn/end` reason cache + `agent/status` `idle` (r

oot agents only) |
| Trigger "compact" / compaction failure | `session/event` → `compaction/end` |
|
Trigger "question" | `approval/request` waterfall (toast + DSH panel) + `tools/execute` for `ask_us

er_question` |
| Done/compact/alert/notice toast | Resident .NET helper `notify` op; WinRT `Windows.

UI.Notifications`, `NotifyIcon` balloon fallback. No per-notification process |
| Interactive approv
al toast | DSH's own approval panel still shows; the toast is a remote control using the same `quest
ion` op: one fixed-choice card (`允许一次` / `拒绝`, no free-text input). Its answer is parked for the bro
wser half, which switches to the owning session and clicks the panel; the panel remains the authorit

y. Cancelling the toast leaves the decision to the panel, and an aborted turn retires the toast |
|
Interactive question toast | Resident .NET helper `question` op, spoken to over the child's stdin/st
dout (newline-delimited JSON). One question = one card; several questions = one paged card (`问题 i/n`

, 上一题/下一题/提交), with each page's draft restored through the toast `defaultInput` attribute |
| Questi
on answer receipt | The helper reports the selection and dismisses the question toast; the host park
s it for the browser half, checks the `ask_user_question` tool result, then shows exactly one toast
— `spoken` with the model's first line (filled to the toast width, cut with `…`). No pending, delive

red or title toast |
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations

- Native toast text is compact: only about 4 lines are displayed, so long content is truncated.
- Th
e native selection dropdown may collapse when the pointer moves onto the popup; if the toast is then

dismissed by timeout, the taskbar flash still reminds you, and it stops once DSH is foreground.
- T
he .NET 10 Desktop Runtime is a hard requirement. Without it the helper cannot start and no notifica

tion can be shown; the host logs an explicit error. There is no PowerShell fallback.
- The helper is
a single long-lived process. If it crashes, the next notification asks the host to spawn it again;

until then, notifications are dropped with a log line.
- `FlashWindowEx` uses the system's warm-puls

e highlight; custom colors are not possible.
- Windows never flashes the foreground window — the tas
kbar button only flashes when DSH is in the background; an active flash is stopped by the OS when th

e window comes to the foreground.
- A cancelled turn is reported as "cancelled" (not "task complete"
); set `notifyOnCancel: false` to silence it, or `notifyOnError: false` to silence abnormal-stop ale

rts.
- Notifications are deduplicated per session within `dedupMs` (default 1500 ms). A second `idle

` for an already-reported turn stays quiet.
- Multi-question toasts page by re-showing the native to
ast. Windows animates the old toast out and the new one in, so each page change has a short visual g
ap; the `已答` line carries the context across it. Multi-question cards always use the long duration (

about 25 s).
- A custom answer wins over the dropdown selection on the same page, exactly like the p

revious single-question toast; clear the text box if you only want the dropdown choice.
- The receip
t cannot be faked by the UI: “spoken” is the model's own first line (cut with … to fit one toast lin
e) and is the only toast shown after submitting. If the model produces no visible text (for example

it immediately calls another tool), no receipt toast appears at all.
[该节后续省略]
